scenes.vo: Meet HigherSquare 360: one system to run your finance, sales, purchasing, inventory and people, with industry modules you switch on when you need them.

scenes.label: Pricing and plans
scenes.vo: It all starts on our website. HigherSquare 360 brings your finance, sales and teams into one place, so everyone works from the same numbers.
Pricing is simple and up front. Choose monthly or annual billing, and see exactly how many users and which modules each plan includes.
You can even preview the mobile app before you sign up.

scenes.label: Create your workspace
scenes.vo: Signing up takes about a minute. Pick a plan, here the Business plan, with a fourteen-day free trial.
Enter your business name, and your workspace address is filled in and checked for you.
Choose your industry and country. The currency, taxes and chart of accounts are set up to match.
Add your name, work email and a password, accept the terms, and create your workspace.

scenes.label: Your new workspace
scenes.vo: Your workspace is ready straight away. Sign in, and you land on your own dashboard, ready for your first customers, products and invoices.
Now let's step into a company that has been running on HigherSquare 360 for a few months.

scenes.label: Dashboard
scenes.vo: The dashboard shows the whole business at a glance. The executive highlights show portfolio value, receivables, and your net result for the period.
Charts compare what you billed with what you collected, and age what customers still owe. Alerts flag anything that needs your attention.
And global search finds any customer, item or document in a second.

scenes.label: Sales: quote to invoice
scenes.vo: Sales flows from quote, to sales order, to invoice, and each step carries over to the next, so nothing is typed twice.
The invoices page shows what you invoiced this year, what is outstanding, and what is overdue.
Here we raise a new invoice. Pick the customer, describe the work, enter the quantity and price, and choose the tax. The totals are worked out for you.
Save and issue it, and the invoice is numbered, posted to the general ledger, and ready to print or email with your branding.

scenes.label: Receipts and customers
scenes.vo: When the customer pays, record the receipt, and see every receipt in one list.
Open the customer to see their total sales, what they owe, their payment terms, and the full history of invoices and receipts.

scenes.label: Purchasing and inventory
scenes.vo: Purchasing follows the same path. A requisition asks for what is needed.
It becomes a purchase order to the supplier, with every line tracked from ordered, to received, to billed.
Goods receipts bring the stock in, and supplier bills are matched and scheduled for payment.
Stock on hand shows every item by warehouse, with quantity, average cost and value, updated by every receipt and every sale.

scenes.label: Finance and reports
scenes.vo: Finance is built in, not bolted on. Here is the chart of accounts, and the journals that every sale, purchase and payroll posts automatically.
Reports are always up to date: the trial balance, the income statement and the balance sheet, for any period, in a click.
Set budgets for the year, and compare them with what actually happened.

scenes.label: Approvals
scenes.vo: Approvals keep you in control. Anyone can request approval for a purchase, a payment or an expense,
and it waits for the right person's sign-off, on the web or on their phone.

scenes.label: HR and payroll
scenes.vo: HR and payroll live in the same place. Every employee has a record with their role, their department and their pay.
Attendance and leave are tracked day by day, and leave requests go through approval.
Payroll runs every month in a few clicks. Each run shows gross pay, deductions and net pay for every employee, and posts straight to the books.
Then, switch on the modules your industry needs.
Real estate manages properties, units and occupancy, with leases and rent billing.
Projects track tasks on a board, with timesheets and project billing.
The point of sale terminal sells at the counter, from your live product list and stock.
CRM follows every lead and opportunity through your sales pipeline.
Manufacturing plans bills of materials and work orders.
And there is more: services and retainers, retail stores and price lists, and distribution routes with van sales.

scenes.label: Control and security
scenes.vo: You decide which modules are switched on for your business.
Users and roles control who can see and do what.
Everyone can protect their sign-in with two-factor authentication.
And the whole app also works in Arabic, right to left.
HigherSquare 360. Your whole business, in one place. Start your free trial today.

scenes.label: HigherSquare 360 mobile
scenes.vo: And your business goes wherever you go, with the HigherSquare 360 app.

scenes.label: Secure sign-in
scenes.vo: A short tour shows what the app can do. Then sign in securely, with two-factor if you use it, and choose your workspace.

scenes.label: Overview
scenes.vo: The overview shows the same live numbers as the web dashboard: sales, cash, receivables and alerts, right on your phone.

scenes.label: Invoices, receipts, customers
scenes.vo: Look up any invoice, receipt or customer in seconds. Open an invoice to see every line, its status and what is still owed.

scenes.label: Approvals on the go
scenes.vo: Approve requests on the go, so nothing waits for you to get back to your desk.

scenes.label: HR on the go
scenes.vo: HR travels with you too: look up any employee, and review each month's payroll run, right from your phone.

scenes.label: Every module, one tap away
scenes.vo: Every module you use is one tap away, from real estate and projects to point of sale and manufacturing.

scenes.label: HigherSquare 360
scenes.vo: HigherSquare 360. On the web, and in your pocket.
